title: Ur
summary: Ur, now Tell el-Muqayyar near Nasiriyah in southern Iraq, was one of the main Sumerian cities, with a moon-god temple precinct and the Royal Cemetery dug by Woolley in 1922-1934. Settlement began in the Ubaid period, perhaps in the fifth millennium BCE, and the last occupation was in the fourth century BCE.

uncertainty.note: Start: Penn Museum (Mallowan, 1960) says settlement began perhaps in the fifth millennium B.C. in the Al Ubaid period. End: the last occupation in the fourth century B.C.

importance.justification: One of the great cities of Sumer, with the best-preserved ziggurat of Mesopotamia and the Royal Cemetery, part of a UNESCO World Heritage property.
